patients.summary: Healthy graphic designer in her mid-twenties who joined the practice in September 2024. Two self-limited episodes of acute urticaria in April and December 2025, seen by dermatology and then allergy, with normal labs and no trigger found; cetirizine as needed since.

documents.title: New Member Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called about membership. Lives in Holyoke, works remotely as a designer, has employer PPO. Wants a doctor she can actually reach. Went over membership terms, she signed up online during the call. Booked new patient physical 9/10 at 9:20. Release of records signed for her old primary care office, faxed today. No need to fast. Asked her to bring her vaccine card if she has it.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
New patient, establishing care.

25F, graphic designer (works from home, freelance plus one agency contract). Here mainly to have a doctor; no complaints today. Sleeps ok, walks most evenings, does some yoga.

PMH: none. No surgeries. No hospitalizations.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: NKDA.
Family hx: mother with seasonal allergies. Father has asthma. No early heart disease or cancers she knows of.
Social: never smoker. Drinks maybe once or twice a month, socially. No drug use. Single, lives with a roommate.
Gyn: menses regular. Last Pap 6/2023 at her old office, normal (record reviewed).

ROS: negative in full.

Exam: well-appearing, NAD. Vitals reviewed, normal. HEENT normal, TMs clear, no thyromegaly or nodes. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin clear, no rashes. Extremities no edema. Neuro grossly normal. Mood bright, affect full.

PHQ-2: 0.

A/P: healthy 25 yo woman, establishing care.
- One-time HIV and hep C screens today, plus a baseline lipid panel.
- Flu shot today. Tdap good until 2029. HPV done.
- Pap due mid-2026, will do at a physical then.
- COVID: updated shot this fall at her pharmacy, she prefers that.
- Walked her through how to text/call me directly.
Return yearly or sooner prn.

documents.title: Immunization Administration
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Influenza vaccine 0.5 mL IM left deltoid, lot and expiration in immunization record. VIS reviewed. Tolerated, no reaction during observation.

documents.title: Your Recent Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Natalia, your labs from Tuesday are back and all normal. HIV and hepatitis C screens negative, and your cholesterol numbers look great. Nothing to repeat for years. Good to meet you!

documents.title: RE: Your Recent Results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Thank you so much! Nice to have someone I can just message.
